test "Charts Exotics Load"
	status active
	description "Every Corsair Charts exotic installs on a ship that loads, and their attributes add up on the flagship (the Phantom Veil's cloak and cloaked firing, the ramscoops of the Tattletale Scoop and the Smugglers' Run Thruster, the Ghost Lattice's jamming, the scan interference of it and the False Bulkhead); it departs and lands."
	sequence
		inject "Charts Exotics Save"
		call "Load First Savegame"
		assert
			"outfit (installed): Bilge Siphon" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Tattletale Scoop" == 1
			"outfit (installed): False Bulkhead" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Leech Turret" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Tollkeeper Ion Repeater" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Ghost Lattice" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Smugglers' Run Thruster" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Blackwake Broadside" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Mutineer's Heart" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Graverobber's Coil" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Deadeye Lance" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Widow's Kiss" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Black Flag Reaver" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Phantom Veil" == 1
			"flagship attribute: cloak" == 20
			"flagship attribute: cloaked firing" == 4
			"flagship attribute: ramscoop" == 3000
			"flagship attribute: radar jamming" == 6000
			"flagship attribute: scan interference" == 4000
		call "Depart"
		call "Land"
		assert
			"flagship planet: Ruin" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Bilge Siphon" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Tattletale Scoop" == 1
			"outfit (installed): False Bulkhead" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Leech Turret" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Tollkeeper Ion Repeater" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Ghost Lattice" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Smugglers' Run Thruster" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Blackwake Broadside" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Mutineer's Heart" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Graverobber's Coil" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Deadeye Lance" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Widow's Kiss" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Black Flag Reaver" == 1
			"outfit (installed): Phantom Veil" == 1

test "Charts Prototypes Load"
	status active
	description "The five prototype hulls load as ships of their own models with their built-in quirks (the Black Kestrel, the flagship, cloaks with no device); the fleet departs and lands."
	sequence
		inject "Charts Prototypes Save"
		call "Load First Savegame"
		assert
			"ship model (all): Sirocco" == 1
			"ship model (all): Nightjar" == 1
			"ship model (all): Black Kestrel" == 1
			"ship model (all): Hellion" == 1
			"ship model (all): Matriarch" == 1
			"flagship model: Black Kestrel" == 1
			"flagship attribute: cloak" == 8
			"flagship attribute: cloaking energy" == 7000
		call "Depart"
		call "Land"
		assert
			"ship model (all): Sirocco" == 1
			"ship model (all): Nightjar" == 1
			"ship model (all): Black Kestrel" == 1
			"ship model (all): Hellion" == 1
			"ship model (all): Matriarch" == 1

test "Charts Trigger E2E"
	status active
	description "With the Dado loader (mod API 11) and Corsair Charts: pirates jump into Terra Incognita (a system fleet the save adds); the player's escort, ordered to fight the nearest hostile ship, disables or destroys one near the flagship, and the pirate transmits a chart (the saved generator state makes the first roll a drop): a Scorched Star Chart appears in the hold."
	sequence
		inject "Charts Trigger Save"
		call "Load First Savegame"
		assert
			"outfit (cargo): Scorched Star Chart" == 0
		call "Depart"
		label settle
		input
			command none
		apply
			"charts test: settle" ++
		branch settle
			not "charts test: never"
			"charts test: settle" < 120
		label chart
		input
			command nearest
		input
			command fight
		apply
			"charts test: chart" ++
		branch chart
			not "outfit (cargo): Scorched Star Chart"
			"charts test: chart" < 3000
		assert
			"outfit (cargo): Scorched Star Chart" >= 1

				Hyperdrive

			turret 0 5

		"mod data"
			corsair_charts state "{%22version%22:1,%22dice%22:0,%22finished%22:[0,0,0,0],%22abandoned%22:0,%22charts%22:1,%22found%22:[],%22trail%22:{%22active%22:true,%22tier%22:0,%22seed%22:5,%22origin%22:%22Terra Incognita%22,%22index%22:0,%22ambush_at%22:-1,%22ambushed%22:false,%22finale_fleet%22:%22Charts Cache 1.1%22,%22proto%22:%22%22,%22placed%22:0,%22box_items%22:[%22Bilge Siphon%22,%22Corsair Bearer Bond%22],%22box_counts%22:[1,2],%22steps%22:[{%22kind%22:7,%22system%22:%22Terra Incognita%22,%22text%22:%22The chart ends in Terra Incognita.%22,%22hint%22:%22Board it.%22}]}}"
		account
			credits 10000000
			score 400
			history
		visited "Terra Incognita"
		"visited planet" Ruin

test-data "Charts Finale Boarding"
	category mission
	contents
		mission "Charts Test: Boarding"
			invisible
			boarding
			destination Ruin

test "Charts Finale E2E"
	status active
	description "With the Dado loader (mod API 11) and Corsair Charts: an easy trail at its finale in Terra Incognita. Departing places the cache (a derelict); the player boards it and takes what it holds; the manifest opens the strongbox (a Bilge Siphon and 2 bearer bonds, besides the 4 bonds in the cache's hold), and the trail counts as finished."
	sequence
		inject "Charts Finale Boarding"
		inject "Charts Finale Save"
		call "Load First Savegame"
		assert
			"corsair charts: trails finished" == 0
		call "Depart"
		label settle
		input
			command none
		apply
			"charts test: settle" ++
		branch settle
			not "charts test: never"
			"charts test: settle" < 120
		input
			command board
		label boarded
		input
			command none
		apply
			"charts test: boarded" ++
		branch boarded
			not "Charts Test: Boarding: offered"
			"charts test: boarded" < 3000
		assert
			"Charts Test: Boarding: offered" == 1
		label plunder
		input
			key t
		apply
			"charts test: plunder" ++
		branch plunder
			not "outfit (cargo): Corsair Manifest"
			"charts test: plunder" < 40
		input
			key t
		input
			key t
		input
			key t
		input
			key d
		label opened
		input
			command none
		apply
			"charts test: opened" ++
		branch opened
			not "corsair charts: trails finished"
			"charts test: opened" < 3000
		assert
			"corsair charts: trails finished" == 1
			"outfit (cargo): Bilge Siphon" == 1
			"outfit (cargo): Corsair Bearer Bond" >= 6
			"outfit (cargo): Corsair Manifest" == 0
